name: tracker-dispatcher
goal: Port Tracker 122e190 launch intent, token claims, session adoption and run transitions through atomic injected persistence

evidence: Pinned 122e190 dispatcher and run log. Verify explicit and due intent, reachable denial and sole-owner outage fallback, one claim per token, queued/running/verifying/finished transitions, adopted sessions, retry escalation and atomic receipt writes. Use artificial clocks and records only.

Implemented an injectable TrackerDispatcherService, token-bound ownership and due admission, an atomic runner reservation and receipt model, and pure reconciliation for startup, session adoption, verification, answers and retry.

19 test cases with disposable SQLite and one Vitest worker passed through the registered Harness scenario; captured eight output and assertion artifacts. Cases include launch idempotence, due grant and fresh admission, atomic rollback, session adoption, stale verification, answers, retries and receipts.
